high_level_description: The image shows six identical decorative tiles arranged in two rows of three on a plain white surface. Each tile features a symmetrical, intricate design with a central motif that resembles a flower or star. The design is composed of various geometric shapes and patterns, including: A black central shape with a blue diamond at its center. Surrounding this are yellow and red petals or points. Gray and light gray curved lines form an ornate border around the central motif. The overall color scheme includes black, white, gray, yellow, red, and blue.
